svg.title: Observation model
svg.desc: A SCADA master reaches an SEL-751A protective relay through one programmable switch. A passive adversary taps the master-facing link, the only part of the path it observes, which is shaded; the relay-facing link and the switch's two internal loopback lanes, one for reads and one for control, are dashed and are observed by neither the adversary nor the authors.
